lead.headline: Magnitude 7.7 quake off Flores kills at least 20 in Indonesia
lead.dek: Landslides cut the island's main highway; a tsunami warning was lifted after no sea-level change.
body: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck off the Indonesian island of Flores at 5:58 a.m. local time Saturday, killing at least 20 people and injuring six, the head of the Maumere search and rescue agency, Fathur Rahman, said. The U.S. Geological Survey put the epicenter 68 kilometers north-northwest of Ende at a depth of 10 kilometers.

Eight of the dead were recovered from a landslide at Reok village, and landslides in Ende regency cut the Trans-Flores highway, the 700-kilometer road running the length of the island. About 2,000 villagers in Nagekeo regency left for shelters. Indonesia's BMKG agency issued a tsunami warning and lifted it after no significant sea-level change; three aftershocks followed within 30 minutes.

briefs.headline: Mangione pleads guilty to federal stalking counts
briefs.summary: He admitted Friday to two stalking counts in the 2024 killing of UnitedHealthcare chief Brian Thompson. Sentencing is Dec. 18.

briefs.headline: Justice Dept. asks high court to restart ballroom work
briefs.summary: The Justice Department sought a stay Friday of a D.C. Circuit order halting the $400M White House ballroom. Work stops Aug. 21.

briefs.headline: Haitians in Springfield summoned for ankle monitors
briefs.summary: Ohio residents who lost Temporary Protected Status in July were called to an ICE facility for monitors. ICE has not said why.

briefs.headline: Congo Ebola outbreak passes 2,100 deaths
briefs.summary: More than 4,600 cases are confirmed in the Bundibugyo outbreak declared in May. WHO said it is moving faster than any previous one.

briefs.headline: Wildfire death in Croatia as fires spread across Europe
briefs.summary: A body was found at Omis, where 40 were treated in Split and 2,000 left coastal villages. Fires also burned in France, Germany and Greece.

briefs.headline: Trump says he will declare Hormuz a U.S. territory
briefs.summary: He said in New York on Friday it would follow Iran's defeat. Iran's Kazem Gharibabadi said it "cannot be taken over by a tweet."

briefs.headline: Morrisey extends storm emergency in 12 counties
briefs.summary: The July 21 declaration runs on in Barbour, Upshur, Lewis and nine others, to Sept. 19. About 1,300 Upshur homes were hit.

briefs.headline: Lottery director says Greenbrier need not close its casino
briefs.summary: Acting director David Bradley wrote that walling off the new holding company would let the casino run pending a vote. About 90 jobs are at stake.

regional.item: About 25 people turned out Thursday as Lubeck PSD asked the county for 30% more on water and 14% on sewer.

fishing.line: 179 cfs and falling - prime wading water.
Sound highs 10:57 a.m. and 11:19 p.m. at Hampstead; no water temperature reported.

briefs.headline: No. 20 West Virginia opens with a 2-0 win over Dayton
briefs.summary: Sophia Nickel scored 54 seconds into the second half Thursday and an own goal off a Maya Leoni corner doubled it.

briefs.headline: Reds blank Miami 1-0; Pirates beat Boston 8-4
briefs.summary: Chase Burns went to 14-2 with a 2.47 ERA in the Cincinnati win. Bubba Chandler took the decision at Pittsburgh.

briefs.headline: Sumo's summer tour reaches Akita; September sold out
briefs.summary: The Japan Sumo Association lists the regional tour at Akita on Saturday and every date of the September Tokyo tournament as sold out.

briefs.headline: Blood immune cells enter the human brain in middle age
briefs.summary: Stanford traced DNA mutations in paired blood and brain tissue, finding cells that cross in and become microglia. The effect is absent in mice.

briefs.headline: Estrogen-only therapy tracks with lower dementia odds
briefs.summary: Across 21,462 women, users had 39% lower odds of a dementia diagnosis. The authors said it is not proof of cause.
